data_format_caveats: KFS PBD0000062 use page calls imdo.zip a SHP set and reports projected GRS80/TM central coordinates and geometry type Polygon; other older private derivative advertises polyline and EPSG:5179. Inspect actual geometry type and the accompanying .prj before any comparison.
Never take projected x/y meters as GPS WGS84 lon/lat, and never convert a Polygon border to a 'forest road centerline' automatically.
Do not use a WMS map image (raster) as proof of centimeter- or meter-scale connection geometry.
conditions_before_running: Acquire the actual KFS imdo.zip from the official service with appropriate license/terms; inspect SHP, SHX, DBF and .prj (ask data provider for the CRS if .prj is missing).
Only export actual line centerline geometries; if KFS source is polygons, refuse rather than fabricate a line.
Reproject using .prj's original CRS (with GDAL/ogr2ogr or QGIS) to WGS84 GeoJSON, then use the comparison tool.
Even 15-meter, 70%-length geometry correspondence indicates only possible alignment; confirmation of present-day access/closures requires official park/forest restrictions.
limitation: Source files not downloaded due to interactive application; matching has deliberately NOT been run. No official designation, official geometry match, legal access or current closure decision is asserted.
